methodologyNotes: Roster covers 10 currently-available outdoor pizza ovens across gas, multi-fuel, and electric-adjacent categories spanning 2016-2026, including the Ooni Karu 2 Pro (Oct 2024) and the Bertello SimulFIRE 16 (pre-order, est. shipping July 2026). The two Ooni Volt electric ovens (Volt 2 and discontinued Volt 12) were REMOVED: Ooni now officially classifies the Volt line as indoor electric ovens (Volt 2 product page states 'suitable for indoor use only'), so they fall outside an outdoor-pizza-oven roster; Volt 12 is additionally discontinued with no current published USD price. Sources consulted: official manufacturer pages (ooni.com, us.gozney.com, bertello.com, fireflypizzaovens.com for Witt US, halocooks.com, homedepot.com for Solo Stove MSRP) and independent reviews (palapizza.com). Boolean spec fields reflect manufacturer-stated features; max_temp_f values are manufacturer-claimed maximums; weight_lb is unboxed oven weight; preheat_minutes is manufacturer-stated time to maximum temperature. Prices are USD as listed on official or primary US retail pages at time of access. Each price and headline spec re-verified 2026-06-19. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
